3:21 as an individual whose family member's phone got stolen so many times, e-sim is actually good for tracking. Android already has settings that won't allow, data off, switch off, access to quick settings without unlocking the phone, but thieves can still take out sim and u won't be able to track it. But with e-sim now they can't even do that so it will stay on until the battery dies, giving us more time to track.
